description: Ghazi Fabrics International Limited was incorporated in Pakistan on 30 April 1989 as a private limited company and converted to a public limited company on 7 January 1990; the chairman's message dates its coming into existence to 1990, when it was set up in 18 months as a vertically composite unit of two spinning mills and one weaving mill. It produces poly-cotton and CVC yarn — carded and combed, for weaving and hosiery — under its own "PANTHER" brand, core-spun Lycra yarn for its own weaving mill, and woven fabric for apparel and work-wear. It sells yarn into the Far East and European markets and exports fabric to Europe, the USA and the Far East.

products.name: PANTHER yarn
products.summary: A-grade poly-cotton and CVC yarn in different blend ratios, carded and combed, for weaving and hosiery, in counts from Ne 6 to Ne 60.

products.name: Core-spun Lycra yarn
products.summary: Core-spun yarn using Lycra, produced for the company's own weaving mill.

products.name: Woven fabric
products.summary: Fabric from dobby-equipped Toyota air-jet looms — twills, drills, poplins, satins and sateens up to high thread-count fine qualities, from bull denim to T-600 — for apparel and work-wear.
